properties.registration: Affine PDF-page to WGS84, using existing station numbers 3.2, 3.3, 3.5 and 3.6
properties.accuracy_note: Control residual is not independent positional accuracy. Rip arrows are anchored to an OSM shoreline from PDF positions and directions; they do not verify live current positions. Do not use for navigation or rescue dispatch.
properties.place_alignment: 25 named places use OSM coordinates. Other place marks are estimates from the PDF page fitted to those places and four GPS stations; still provisional.
